title: A personal task board
oneLine: Lists, cards, due dates, for you alone.
why: For one person, this is a list with drag-and-drop, and every AI tool's demo is basically this app. It stops being easy the moment you need it shared with a team.
tool: Lovable, Bolt or Replit free tier
keep: Phone apps, shared boards, reminders that reliably fire.
breaks: Reminders. Push notifications are the part beginners always underestimate.
